info.title: Payment Links and Buttons
info.description: The Payment Links and Buttons API enables you to programmatically create and manage payment links and buttons. Use this API to generate shareable URLs, retrieve payment details, and update configurations without building custom checkout flows.

tags.name: Payment-Links
tags.description: Use the /links/{id} resource to retrieve details about payment links.

tags.name: Create-Context
tags.description: Use the `/links/{id}/create-context` resource to create context (order creation) associated with payment link.

tags.name: Pay-Context
tags.description: Use the `/links/{id}/pay` resource to pay the context associated with payment link.

tags.name: Context-Details
tags.description: Use the `/links/{id}/contexts/{context_id}` resource to retrieve the context details associated with payment link.

tags.name: Acquire-Shipping-Options
tags.description: Use the `/links/{id}/shipping-options` resource to load the shipping options and updated amount of the context associated with payment link.

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: Use the `/carts` resource to create or get cart and `/carts/{id}` resource to update or get cart.

tags.name: Payment-Resources
tags.description: Use the `/payment-resources` resource to create or get payment resources and `/payment-resources/{id}` resource to update or get payment resource.

post.summary: Creates a payment resource for a single-item purchase
post.description: Creates a new PayPal payment resource for a single-item Buy Now checkout. Returns the full resource details including ID, payment link url, and status.

adjustable_quantity.title: Adjustable Quantity
adjustable_quantity.description: Allows customers to change the quantity of this item during checkout.

maximum.description: The maximum quantity customers can select. Must be between 1 and 100. Setting this value enables the quantity picker at checkout.

code_snippet.title: Code snippets
code_snippet.description: Code snippets holds the code needed to inject payment resources for merchant experience. Only applicable when integration_mode="BUTTON" & type="BUY_NOW".

code_snippet_stacked.title: Code snippets for stacked button
code_snippet_stacked.description: Code snippets to place the PayPal buttons on your site. It supports 2 flavours "REACT", "HTML". Applicable only when integration_mode="BUTTON" & type="BUY_NOW".

framework.description: To identify the flavour of code snippets for stacked button (e.g. "HTML", "REACT").

oneOf.description: Code snippets to add stacked buttons to your site with HTML
Code snippets to add stacked buttons to your site with React

head.description: Paste this code in your website’s head (or at the top of your page’s body above the Part 2 code) only once per page.

body.description: Paste this code in your page's body.

button_placement.description: Paste this code in the page where you want the button to show up, near your product.

code_snippet_stacked_list.description: Code snippets to place the PayPal buttons on your site.

currency_code.description: The [three-character ISO-4217 currency code](/api/rest/reference/currency-codes/) that identifies the currency.

customer_note.title: Customer Note
customer_note.description: Label for a custom field to collect additional information from customers about this item (e.g., "Engraving text" or "Special instructions"). Can be set as mandatory.

required.description: Whether this custom field is required for checkout. Set to true to make the field mandatory.

label.description: The label displayed to customers for this custom input field (e.g., "Enter engraving text" or "Delivery instructions").

customer_note_list.description: Label for a custom field to collect additional information from customers about this item (e.g., "Engraving text" or "Special instructions"). Can be set as mandatory.

date_time.description:
The date and time, in [Internet date and time format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6). Seconds are required while fractional seconds are optional.
Note: The regular expression provides guidance but does not reject all invalid dates.

dimension.title: Variant of Payment Resource
dimension.description: Variant dimension structure with multiple options. Each variant can have multiple options, and only one variant can be marked as primary.

name.description: The name of the variant dimension (e.g., "Size", "Color").

primary.description: Only one dimension has primary set to true. Only options in the primary dimension can have unit_amount.

dimension_list.description: List of variant dimensions available for this product. Each dimension can have multiple options.

label.description: The display label for this option (e.g., "Large").

unit_amount.description: Unit Price of this option, including value and currency code.

integration_mode.title: Integration Mode
integration_mode.description: Determines how the payment resource is presented to customers. Currently, only LINK is supported, which generates a PayPal-hosted payment page with a shareable URL. This value is immutable after creation.

oneOf.description: Generates a hosted payment page accessible via URL. Currently the only supported mode.

line_item.title: Line Item of Payment Resource
line_item.description: List of individual item in payment resource.

name.description: The product or service name displayed to customers during checkout.

product_id.description: Your internal identifier for this product.

description.description: Detailed information about the product or service shown to customers during checkout. Use this to provide additional context, specifications, or terms.

unit_amount.description: The price per unit of this item, including the numeric value and currency code.

collect_shipping_address.description: Prompts customers for a shipping address during checkout for this item. Set to true for physical goods that require delivery, false for digital goods.

variants.description: Product variants such as size, color, or material presented to customers during checkout. Each variant (e.g., "Size") can have up to 10 options (e.g., "S", "M", "L", "XL"). Supports up to 5 variants total. One variant can be designated as primary to enable different prices per option.

adjustable_quantity.description: Allows customers to change the quantity of this item during checkout.

line_item_list.description: List of individual item in payment resource.

href.description: The complete target URL. To make the related call, combine the method with this [URI Template-formatted](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6570) link. For pre-processing, include the `$`, `(`, and `)` characters. The `href` is the key HATEOAS component that links a completed call with a subsequent call.

rel.description: The [link relation type](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5988#section-4), which serves as an ID for a link that unambiguously describes the semantics of the link. See [Link Relations](https://www.iana.org/assignments/link-relations/link-relations.xhtml).

method.description: The HTTP method required to make the related call.

link_description_list.description: An array of request-related [HATEOAS links](/api/rest/responses/#hateoas-links) that are either relevant to the issue by providing additional information or offering potential resolutions.

money.title: Money
money.description: The currency and amount for a financial transaction, such as a balance or payment due.

value.description:
The value, which might be:
  • An integer for currencies like `JPY` that are not typically fractional.
  • A decimal fraction for currencies like `TND` that are subdivided into thousandths.
For the required number of decimal places for a currency code, see [Currency Codes](/api/rest/reference/currency-codes/).

payment_link.description: The generated payment link URL for the transaction (present if integration_mode is link).

create_time.description: The date and time that this payment resource was created.

update_time.description: The date and time that the payment resource was updated.

payment_resource_detailed_response.title: Payment Resource Detailed Response
payment_resource_detailed_response.description: Detailed response for Payment resource, which include code snippets for payment resources.

code_snippets.description: Code snippets holds the code needed to inject payment resources for merchant experience.

return_url.description: URL to which the customer is redirected after completing the transaction.

payment_resource_id.description: Unique identifier for the payment resource (link or button).

payment_resource_type.title: Payment Resource Type
payment_resource_type.description: The type of payment resource. Once a payment resource is created, this field cannot be changed.

oneOf.description: Single-item purchase with immediate payment completion. Creates a payment resource for one product or service that processes payment in real-time during checkout.

reusable.title: Reusable
reusable.description: Indicates if the payment resource can be used multiple times or only once.

oneOf.description: The payment resource can be used multiple times.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.description: Shipping fee for this item. Shipping fee is displayed separately to customers during checkout.

type.description: The method used to calculate shipping costs.

oneOf.description: Applies a fixed shipping fee regardless of quantity (e.g., $5.00 whether customer buys 1 or 10 units).
Calculates shipping based on the merchant's PayPal account shipping settings. Requires merchant to have shipping rates configured in their PayPal Business Settings.

value.description: The shipping value or reference. For FLAT, enter the fixed cost (e.g., "5" for $5.00). For PREFERENCE, must be set to "PROFILE".

shipping_list.description: Shipping fee for this item. Shipping fee is displayed separately to customers during checkout.

single.title: Code snippets for single PayPal button.
single.description: Code snippet to place the PayPal button on your site. Applicable only when integration_mode="BUTTON" & type="BUY_NOW".

body.description: Paste this code in your page's body tag, ideally near your product. You can repeat this for each payment resource you have on the page.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: Taxes applied to this item. Tax is displayed separately to customers during checkout.

name.description: Internal label for this tax (e.g., "Sales Tax", "VAT"). Not visible to customer.

type.description: The method used to calculate this tax.

oneOf.description: Applies a flat percentage to the item amount (e.g., 10% sales tax).
Calculates tax based on the merchant's PayPal account tax settings. Requires merchant to have tax rates configured in their PayPal account Settings.

value.description: The tax amount or reference. For PERCENTAGE, enter the numeric percentage value (e.g., "10" for 10%). For PREFERENCE, must be set to "PROFILE". Maximum 20 characters.

tax_list.description: Taxes applied to this item. Tax is displayed separately to customers during checkout.

variants.title: Variant of Payment Resource
variants.description: Product variants such as size, color, or material presented to customers during checkout. Each variant (e.g., "Size") can have up to 10 options (e.g., "S", "M", "L", "XL"). Supports up to 5 variants total. One variant can be designated as primary to enable different prices per option.

paypal_request_id.name: PayPal-Request-Id
paypal_request_id.description: The server stores keys for 6 hours.

content_type.name: Content-Type
content_type.description: The media type. Required for operations with a request body. The value is `application/<format>`, where `format` is `json`.

paypal_auth_assertion.name: PayPal-Auth-Assertion
paypal_auth_assertion.description: An API-caller-provided JSON Web Token (JWT) assertion that identifies the merchant. For details, see PayPal-Auth-Assertion.

page_size.name: page_size
page_size.description: A non-negative, non-zero integer indicating the maximum number of results to return at one time. This parameter must only be provided on initial request and not combined with page_token.

page_token.name: page_token
page_token.description: An opaque value representing the page to navigate to.

total_required.name: total_required
total_required.description: A boolean indicating total number of items and pages are expected to be returned in the response.

id.name: id
id.description: The payment resource id for which to show details.
